_comment: Sweep 2 — wing width x stop-loss interaction. Wing width sets max-loss per IC; stop-loss sets when we cut a losing position before max-loss is realised. The default 8x40 combo (400pt wing, 40% premium-up stop) gave -3.90 Sharpe on gdfl_v2. Tighter stops should reduce per-trade loss; wider wings increase credit but also max-loss. Cartesian 4x4 = 16 configs.
